keyMappings:
# Only these normal-mode shortcuts are enabled on websites.
unmapAll
map f LinkHints.activateMode
map o Vomnibar.activate
map j scrollDown
map k scrollUp
map b goBack
map B goForward
map w removeTab
map t createTab
map T restoreTab
map r reload
map J previousTab
map K nextTab
map gt Vomnibar.activateTabSelection
map / enterFindMode
map n performFind
map N performBackwardsFind
map gg scrollToTop
map G scrollToBottom
map ? showHelp
searchEngines:
# Type o, then a keyword and your query.
# General and reference
g: https://www.google.com/search?q=%s Google
d: https://duckduckgo.com/?q=%s DuckDuckGo
w: https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Special:Search&search=%s Wikipedia
tr: https://translate.google.com/?sl=auto&tl=en&text=%s&op=translate Translate to English

# Development and Linux
gh: https://github.com/search?q=%s&type=repositories GitHub repositories
gc: https://github.com/search?q=%s&type=code GitHub code
aw: https://wiki.archlinux.org/index.php?title=Special:Search&search=%s ArchWiki
ap: https://archlinux.org/packages/?q=%s Arch packages
aur: https://aur.archlinux.org/packages?K=%s AUR

# Media, places and Magic
yt: https://www.youtube.com/results?search_query=%s YouTube
gm: https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=%s Google Maps
sf: https://scryfall.com/search?q=%s Scryfall cards

# Native first-result shortcuts (append 1).
g1: https://www.google.com/search?q=%s&btnI=1 Google First
d1: https://duckduckgo.com/?q=%5C%s DuckDuckGo First
